flags.text: "Anchor assistant citation badges in answer text with previews on hover or keyboard focus. ([#233](https://github.com/goldbarth/ServiceDeskLite/pull/233))" - Although #233 initially added those badges, #244 removed its `AnswerCitationLayout` during integration and deferred inline badges. The shipped Markdown-based badges were reintroduced by #245, so listing #233 as an added feature distorts the integrated result.

"Require the chat system prompt to confirm a write succeeded before reporting it as complete, without asking users to reconfirm requested changes unnecessarily. ([#223](https://github.com/goldbarth/ServiceDeskLite/pull/223))" - #223 instructs the assistant not to claim a write happened unless a tool call was made and its result reported success. It does not require the prompt to confirm the write succeeded.
"You can act on a suggestion directly" - The first suggested step can be a non-actionable caption when no actionable suggestion exists; unmapped suggestions are displayed but cannot be clicked.

"Citations now appear as numbered badges beside matching titles in assistant answers" - This rephrases the earlier inline-citation implementation, which was removed during the frontend integration. Inline badges were subsequently reintroduced for sanitized Markdown answers in PR #245; the wording should describe that delivered implementation rather than imply the earlier one remained.
